name: plan-shape
title: Plan shape
kind: A goal with a branch in it, and a human who changes the plan once before saying ok

replies: add a guard: we spend no more than 200 euros
expect: The proposal opens with a TL;DR, then the track, the goal, the guards and the bubbles, each planned bubble with its [Boundary: …] line.
